model: Dielectric GGX with height-correlated Smith visibility, diffuse reflection and bounded diffuse transmission

solarCalibration.source: Poly Haven Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy Pure Sky, official 2K Radiance HDR
solarCalibration.method: Integrate source radiance times equirectangular texel solid angle inside a 1-degree cone around the measured solar disk, then divide by pi. 153 texels are included. The diffuse sky calculation excludes the solar peak separately.
solarCalibration.changedElevationApproximation: RGB air-mass extinction relative to the source elevation, with coefficients [0.15,0.23,0.42]. This spectral tint approximation is not a complete atmospheric radiative-transfer solution.

surfaceOptics.colorInterpretation: Source diffuse color is reflected albedo. Transmitted color is min(0.95-reflected,reflected*transmissionRatio), channelwise, so the source reflected color is retained. GGX directional reflectance reserves the specular share of the energy budget.
surfaceOptics.DFG: 16 perceptual roughness levels in [0.42,1] times 32 view cosines. Each texel integrates the exact runtime correlated GGX direct lobe with 16,384 deterministic equal-area incident directions. Bilinear reconstruction uses the same values in WGSL and GLSL. Runtime quantizes these integrals to a 32x16 R8UNORM texture and uses hardware bilinear sampling. Quantization error is at most 1/510; shader constants are not dynamically indexed.
surfaceOptics.environmentSpecular: GGX directional reflectance multiplies reflected diffuse-SH sky evaluated along the mirror direction, under the same crown/stand shelter. This low-frequency approximation restores grazing sky energy but does not reproduce detailed sharp cloud reflections.
surfaceOptics.normalFiltering: Far-tree mean-normal length widens roughness and blends oriented sky irradiance toward the degree-zero SH mean.

verification.scope: White, green-leaf and mixed-color albedos across supported roughness, view-angle and transmission cases. These tests cover the local material model; scene-level indirect lighting and shelter remain approximate.
